login.description: Your credentials pass through our server over HTTPS to reach UPPCL, but are never stored or logged. The entire codebase is open-source.
login.trust_banner: Open-source & no storage — your credentials are never saved
login.trust_sub: Everything is open-source. Self-host for full privacy.
login.pitch_1: Credentials travel over HTTPS through our server to UPPCL. They are never stored, never logged, never persisted.
login.pitch_2: No database. No tracking. No analytics. The entire codebase is open-source — verify every line yourself.
login.pitch_3: Close the tab and your session is gone. Self-host for full privacy — the server runs on a single bun run dev.
login.sign_in_desc: Use the same credentials you use on the official
login.creds_banner_title: Your credentials are never stored or logged
login.creds_banner_desc: Sent over HTTPS to UPPCL. Our server is a relay with no database and no logs.
login.connection_error_desc: Could not reach the UPPCL API. This usually means the upstream server is down or your network is blocking the connection.
